replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI app to check my economics calculations. It was quick and accurate, helping me verify results without frustration. It’s great for quick checks but not for deep learning.

Find the first derivative f’(x). Set it equal to zero and solve for x. Plug those x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. These points are where the graph changes from increasing to decreasing or vice versa.
